responsibility: Implements NetBSD-specific builtin patching for the C-family target. It rewrites selected complex-absolute builtins such as cabs/cabsf/cabsl so their assembler names resolve to the NetBSD C99-prefixed library symbols (__c99_*), updating both explicit and implicit builtin declarations when present. This file is a focused libc/ABI compatibility shim used during builtin setup, distinct from the broader NetBSD header-based target configuration.
same_name_distinction: This is the code implementation in the netbsd group: it performs the actual builtin renaming to NetBSD’s __c99_* library symbols for cabs-family functions, while gcc/config/netbsd.h provides the shared NetBSD configuration and only hooks this behavior in via SUBTARGET_INIT_BUILTINS, and gcc/config/netbsd.opt is just the option table.
